speech.label: speech and language technology for low-resource African languages

vonative.name: Vonative
facts: built a real-time voice-agent system (LiveKit, a custom dialogue state machine and a node-based workflow engine) that combines African-language STT/TTS with LLMs over Nigerian telephony

investigated failure modes in deployed agents: ASR hallucination on local-language audio, and LLMs verbalising tool calls instead of executing them, which I traced to prompt phrasing and weakly typed tool-output schemas
designed a multilingual IVR banking dialogue flow covering five Nigerian languages
targets Nigerian Pidgin and code-switched speech

toyyib.name: Toyyib
facts: designed a pipeline in which the LLM only proposes typed, citation-backed accounting facts from long financial filings, while a deterministic rules engine validates them and performs AAOIFI Shariah screening
missing or conflicting evidence marks only the dependent screens as insufficient
every result binds filing hashes, accepted observations, prompt/schema hashes and model identity, so any verdict can be re-derived and audited
analyst corrections become scoped, reusable mapping rules
evaluated on a real 72-page NGX filing (Docling parsing, OpenAI structured outputs) with per-call and per-run cost limits

sarah.name: Sarah AI
facts: designing graduated autonomy (Review, Supervised, Autonomous) for AI collections agents
routine actions run autonomously within approved limits, while disputes, vulnerability and complaints escalate to humans
autonomy increases per tenant as confidence builds
building an end-to-end agentic collections pipeline (voice, SMS, email) with approval rules and compliance-aware audit logging

invigilx.name: InvigilX
facts: built InvigilX, integrating computer-vision models with a live alert pipeline for real-time anomaly detection
designed a follow-up platform with a hook-chain execution model (frame, detect, track, condition, alert), per-camera real-time streaming and bring-your-own-compute local inference

scholarai.name: ScholarAI
facts: built embedding-based semantic matching (pgvector) between parsed student CVs and scholarship/professor data, with an asynchronous processing pipeline

mazamaza.name: Mazamaza
facts: designed a Redis-backed distributed state engine with atomic operations and fault recovery, plus Cloudflare Durable Objects for per-room state, keeping hundreds of concurrent WebSocket sessions consistent
